title: knowgov gate report
description: What `python harness/gate_cli.py -f json` prints (task-0007): the gate's verdict for one task of one subject's scenario, its findings on the severity ladder, the threshold, the baseline comparison when one was asked for, and the exit code. Version 2 (task-0048); a change is additive or a new version. From version 1: a finding carries `kind` (key, task, stale, suspect_derived), `ref` (the statement or derived output it is about, null for a key or the task) and `related` (a stale statement's verified or approved successors; the invalidated statements a suspect derived output used); a stale statement on a required key is a finding (info when a verified or approved successor replaces it, major when none does) and a suspect derived output is a blocker, so both count toward --fail-on; `stale` and `suspect_derived` are lists of ids instead of counts; the baseline carries `new_suspect`, and a derived output suspect that the baseline did not hold suspect is a regression. A version-1 report still reads as a baseline, holding no derived output suspect.

task.description: the task class of the subject's [tasks] table

store.description: the store adapter: neo4j or rdflib

loaded.description: true: the gate loaded the scenario into the store first; false (--no-load): it read the store as it was

stale.description: the invalidated statements on required keys, by id, superseded or not

suspect_derived.description: the registered derived outputs that used a statement now invalidated, by id

levels.description: every required key's level; what a later run's --baseline FILE compares with

source.description: record, or the path of the baseline file

new_suspect.description: derived outputs suspect now that the baseline did not hold suspect

kind.description: key: a required key's level or flags; task: the task as a whole; stale: an invalidated statement on a required key; suspect_derived: a derived output that used an invalidated statement

key.description: the required key; null for a finding on the task as a whole or on a derived output

level.description: the key's level; a stale statement's own status (invalidated)

ref.description: the statement (stale) or derived output (suspect_derived) by id; null for a key or the task

related.description: stale: the verified or approved successors; suspect_derived: the invalidated statements it used
